nature.name: an overgrown hollow
nature.text: Roots part around a doorway of woven branches. Air drifts out, green and ancient.

volt.name: a humming grotto
volt.text: The rock itself crackles. Static lifts the hairs on your arms as you approach.

flame.name: a smoldering caldera vent
flame.text: Heat breathes from a crack in the basalt. Something glitters deep in the ember-light.

terra.name: a collapsed quarry cave
terra.text: Shattered stone has opened a throat into the earth. Dust settles in perfect stillness.

frost.name: a blue ice cavern
frost.text: Light passes through the walls like stained glass. Your breath freezes mid-sentence.

shadow.name: a lightless burrow
shadow.text: The dark here is older than the night above it. Something watches without eyes.

rift.name: a rift-scarred fissure
rift.text: Reality is thin here. Colors run wrong along the edges of the crack.

_default.name: a mysterious cave
_default.text: A mouth of stone opens in the hillside, breathing cool air. Old claw-marks frame the entrance.
